facts.location: Clause 4.2 (Section 4 Benefit conditions)
verbatim: Days are counted from the date and time of admission to the date and time of discharge shown on the hospital record. Each complete period of 24 consecutive hours counts as one day. Days are not counted by calendar date or by the number of nights.

arithmetic: Duration = 14 Mar 21:40 -> 18 Mar 21:40 is 96h; discharge is 13h20m earlier, so 96h - 13h20m = 82h40m.
Remainder = 82h40m - 72h = 10h40m, which is less than 12 hours, so disregarded (Clause 4.2).
Days of confinement = 3 (within the 60-day annual cap).
Benefit = 3 x S$120 (Adult, Item B) = S$360.
